input.oldString:
install_pip() {
    print_status "Installing pip..."
    
    # Try to install pip using the system package manager
    if command -v pacman &> /dev/null; then
        print_status "Installing python-pip using pacman..."
        sudo pacman -S --noconfirm python-pip
    elif command -v apt &> /dev/null; then
        print_status "Installing python3-pip using apt..."
        sudo apt update && sudo apt install -y python3-pip
    elif command -v dnf &> /dev/null; then
        print_status "Installing python3-pip using dnf..."
        sudo dnf install -y python3-pip
    elif command -v yum &> /dev/null; then
        print_status "Installing python3-pip using yum..."
        sudo yum install -y python3-pip
    elif command -v zypper &> /dev/null; then
        print_status "Installing python3-pip using zypper..."
        sudo zypper install -y python3-pip
    else
        # Fallback: install pip using ensurepip
        print_status "Installing pip using ensurepip..."
        python3 -m ensurepip --user --upgrade
    fi
    
    # Verify pip installation
    if python3 -m pip --version &> /dev/null; then
        PIP_CMD="python3 -m pip"
        print_success "pip installed successfully!"
    else
        print_error "Failed to install pip. Please install it manually."
        exit 1
    fi
}
input.newString:
install_pip() {
    print_status "Installing pip using Python's ensurepip module..."
    
    # Try to install pip using ensurepip (no sudo required)
    if python3 -m ensurepip --user --upgrade 2>/dev/null; then
        print_success "pip installed using ensurepip!"
    else
        print_warning "ensurepip failed. Trying alternative methods..."
        
        # Try downloading and installing pip manually
        if command -v curl &> /dev/null; then
            print_status "Downloading get-pip.py..."
            curl -s https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py -o /tmp/get-pip.py
            python3 /tmp/get-pip.py --user
            rm -f /tmp/get-pip.py
        elif command -v wget &> /dev/null; then
            print_status "Downloading get-pip.py..."
            wget -q https://bootstrap.pypa.io/get-pip.py -O /tmp/get-pip.py
            python3 /tmp/get-pip.py --user
            rm -f /tmp/get-pip.py
        else
            print_error "Cannot install pip automatically."
            print_status "Please install pip manually using your system package manager:"
            if command -v pacman &> /dev/null; then
                echo "  sudo pacman -S python-pip"
            elif command -v apt &> /dev/null; then
                echo "  sudo apt install python3-pip"
            elif command -v dnf &> /dev/null; then
                echo "  sudo dnf install python3-pip"
            elif command -v yum &> /dev/null; then
                echo "  sudo yum install python3-pip"
            fi
            exit 1
        fi
    fi
    
    # Verify pip installation
    if python3 -m pip --version &> /dev/null; then
        PIP_CMD="python3 -m pip"
        print_success "pip is now available!"
    else
        print_error "Failed to install pip. Please install it manually."
        exit 1
    fi
}
